description:
Retype issue ids in the dependency, graph, template and batch-creation commands.

## Background

`commands/dependency.rs` holds 65 production issue-id references and 10 raw-id function signatures, `commands/template.rs` 9 signatures, and `commands/graph.rs` 17 references. Dependency removal matches a prefix against `issue.dependencies` by hand (`commands/dependency.rs:551-572`) instead of using the shared resolver. `remove_dependency` and `remove_dependencies` (`commands/dependency.rs:150,435`) take `dep_id: &str` and `dep_ids: &[String]`; their callers are `main.rs:4114`, the `commands/issue.rs` test module (`:2223,2259,2296,2298,2436,2467,2492`), `crates/jit/tests/fast_issue/bulk_operations_tests.rs:275,296`, `fast_issue/dep_add_atomic_tests.rs:298`, `fast_issue/readiness_coherence_tests.rs:254` and `fast_docs_templates/template_apply_tests.rs:1299`. Short ids are truncated by length at `commands/graph.rs:326,588` and `commands/batch_create.rs:339`, and `commands/batch_create.rs:409` builds a placeholder short id with `"0".repeat(SHORT_ID_LENGTH)`. `commands/template_expand.rs` carries ids of the issues an apply creates. Integration tests call `add_dependency` about 120 times, nearly all with `&String` arguments.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No struct field, enum field or function parameter in `commands/dependency.rs`, `commands/graph.rs`, `commands/template.rs`, `commands/template_expand.rs` or `commands/batch_create.rs` holds an issue id as `String`, `&str` or `Vec<String>`; each uses `IssueId`. Template placeholder ids, which are not issue ids, keep their own type.
- [hard] REQ-02: Executor methods in this family take `&IssueId` and resolve no prefixes, with one exception: dependency removal takes `&IssueIdPrefix` and matches it against the issue's own dependency list, so a dangling dependency can still be removed. Callers that hold full ids, such as templates, batch creation and tests, pass them directly.
- [hard] REQ-03: Dependency removal matches its prefix through the shared resolver over the issue's dependency ids, and no hand-written prefix match remains in this family.
- [hard] REQ-04: Callers of dependency removal pass `IssueIdPrefix`: the CLI parses the user's argument into one without resolving it, and callers that hold an `IssueId` convert it through `IssueIdPrefix::from(&IssueId)`.
- [hard] REQ-05: Short ids in this family come only from `short_id()`, and no site truncates an id by length.
- [hard] REQ-06: No production `IssueIdPrefix` parse and no production `resolve_issue_id` call remains in this family's files.
- [hard] REQ-07: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

`crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is at this point an alias for `String`, and the `IssueIdStaging` trait gives it `short_id()`. Retyping to the alias is compiler-neutral, so this change is checked by its criteria rather than by type errors; a later change replaces the alias with the validated newtype and the compiler then reports any site missed here. Parameters are retyped outside-in: the CLI and server entry points already resolve ids, and callers in this family are retyped before the functions they call in inner layers.
title: Dependency, graph and template commands carry typed issue ids
